name: VerifyLite
summary: Verify before you pay or act: pay-per-call safety checks for sites, transactions and tokens.
description: Remote MCP server for pay-per-call safety checks: website safety (/safe $0.009), token reports (/chain/token-report $0.0098), transaction preflight (/chain/preflight $0.0095) and prompt-injection detection (/injection-check $0.0044). No login or API key; calls are paid per request in USDC on Base via x402, and failed requests are not charged. Official MCP Registry name: io.github.SecondShotAI/verifylite.
